actual_artifacts_targeted_check.method: Read-only stdin Python verification. Constructed the section 3.2 proof in memory under a nonexistent sentinel path. Mocked only inputs() to return a non-dispatch sentinel namespace and the actual sources() inventory, and intercepted only that proof read. All historical receipt, attempt and cell reads used the real completion and SHA256 readers; the real log and judgment were hashed. Invoked main() with --check --judged-recovery and no ledger argument, using its empty ledger state. Patched run_cell, smoke, new_watch and ProcessPoolExecutor to raise on any invocation. Parsed only the last captured stdout line as JSON. No proof, ledger or other file was written.

owner_override: The owner explicitly prohibited smoke and all timed or pool runs. Real smoke and the real-input plain and judged CLI checks are deferred to Claude/operator. real_input_cli_check.note: Both the real-input plain check used to derive the final namespace and the judged check with the completed proof and fresh empty ledger remain operator gates. The sentinel check above does not replace them.

This review provides no new latency, paced-overrun, thermal, contention or scientific M1 outcome evidence.

resolved_findings.issue: A consumption check keyed only to the submitted proof digest could re-admit the used attempt-03 debit after changing its target namespace or ignored metadata.
resolved_findings.resolution: Consumption now follows newer recovery-bearing receipts independently of the submitted proof serialization. A read-only reproduction using actual attempt-03 artifacts and the regression test both verify refusal.

resolved_findings.issue: Scanning only the proof-controlled prior directory allowed relocated copies of hash-pinned history to hide the actual consumed receipt.
resolved_findings.resolution: The scan is anchored to the judgment's authority exp directory as well as the supplied history. The relocated-history regression tests and read-only actual-artifact mapping verify refusal.

resolved_findings.issue: An unrestricted initial quiet wait could exceed a nearly exhausted cumulative allowance before the first cell.
resolved_findings.resolution: The initial deadline is established before preflight and its quiet wait is clipped to the remaining allowance. The mocked preflight test verifies a ten-second remaining cap and no attempt directory on refusal.

verified_properties: Only foreign-load incomplete runs with non-INVALID summaries and verified cleanup can enter the main-only whole-cell restart loop.
The actual main-loop boundaries are tested: at most three discarded runs per cell, at most eight per attempt, and no restart when the 600-second reserve condition fails.

A restart exports the whole stopped row create-only with SHA256 and completion sidecars, records its metadata, waits for quiet and calls the unchanged run_cell again; retained samples are not spliced.
The quiet gate uses the existing process text and unchanged ownership walk, records samples and requires three quiet observations separated by ten-second sleeps at the 20-percent threshold.

Initial and restart quiet waits are bounded by the remaining cumulative allowance. Initial timeout creates no attempt directory; restart timeout yields INCOMPLETE with the exact host-not-quiet reason.
Mocked main accounting includes initial quiet wait, stopped run, restart quiet wait and every retained run.

Discard auditing verifies immutable exports, foreign stop reason, incomplete non-INVALID summary, nonempty final foreign-host evidence, metadata counts, restart budgets and no shared epoch with retained units. Non-foreign discard is refused.
JUDGED2 validates the exact historical receipt, attempt, stopped cell, source, explicit prep2 log, prior judged proof, judgment, finality and cumulative debit pins.
JUDGED2 refuses wrong hashes, wrong previous attempt number, missing final_attempt, wrong judgment hash, stale source inventory, missing restart policy and nonempty ledger.
The prior precell and attempt-03 judged recoveries are refused after consumption. Re-serializing a proof or relocating copied historical artifacts cannot hide the authority exp history.
